result.markdown:
# Call Setup Failures and Dropped Calls in Grand Tunis

- **Classification:** incident
- **Root cause:** bad_change at `S-TUN-007`
- **Confidence:** high (Changes occurred at 17:31 matching the KPI degradation onset at 17:30, with maintenance and external events checked and ruled out for these sites.)
- **Impact:** 2026-09-29 17:30 to 2026-09-30 01:13
- **Cause time:** 2026-09-29 17:31
- **Affected:** S-TUN-007, S-TUN-009, S-TUN-015

## Summary

Parameter optimisation batch OPT-21 was applied to sites S-TUN-007, S-TUN-009, and S-TUN-015 at 2026-09-29 17:31, causing RRC success rate drops and drop rate spikes.

RRC success drops and drop rate spikes on S-TUN-007, S-TUN-009, and S-TUN-015 starting at 2026-09-29 17:30 and recovering at 2026-09-30 01:13 upon rollback.

## Timeline

- 2026-09-29 17:30: RRC success drops and drop rate spikes began on S-TUN-007, S-TUN-009, and S-TUN-015. [T1, T6]
- 2026-09-29 17:31: Parameter optimisation batch OPT-21 applied via config_push. [CHG-2026-0073, CHG-2026-0074, CHG-2026-0075]
- 2026-09-30 01:13: Configuration changes rolled back, clearing anomalies and alarms. [T1, CHG-2026-0073, CHG-2026-0074, CHG-2026-0075]

## Evidence

- RRC success drops and drop rate spikes affected S-TUN-007, S-TUN-009, and S-TUN-015 starting at 2026-09-29 17:30. [T1, T6]
- Parameter optimisation batch OPT-21 was applied to S-TUN-007, S-TUN-009, and S-TUN-015 at 2026-09-29 17:31. [CHG-2026-0073, CHG-2026-0074, CHG-2026-0075]
- PRB utilisation showed no deviation on S-TUN-007, S-TUN-009, and S-TUN-015. [T6]
- No maintenance window was scheduled on S-TUN-007, S-TUN-009, S-TUN-015 and its parents between 2026-09-29 12:00 and 2026-09-29 23:59. [T7]
- Changes were rolled back at 2026-09-30 01:13, resolving the issue. [CHG-2026-0073, CHG-2026-0074, CHG-2026-0075]

## Hypotheses

1. **bad_change** at S-TUN-007: confirmed. Parameter optimisation batch OPT-21 changes applied at 17:31 directly preceded KPI degradation at 17:30, and rollback cleared the incident. [T1, CHG-2026-0073, CHG-2026-0074, CHG-2026-0075]
2. **expected_event** at S-TUN-001: rejected. The stadium event EVT-006 caused traffic congestion on S-TUN-001, S-TUN-002, and S-TUN-003, but not on the affected RRC failure sites. [EVT-006, ALR-0036]

## Ruled out

- EVT-006: Football match affected different sites (S-TUN-001, S-TUN-002, S-TUN-003) with PRB congestion rather than RRC failures.
- ALM-000519: High temperature warning on S-TUN-009 cleared hours before the incident started.
- ALM-000497: Minor link degraded on LNK-TUN-02-B cleared long before the incident.
- ALM-000515: High temperature warning on S-TUN-004 cleared before the incident window.

## Recommended actions

- Review parameter optimisation batch OPT-21 settings before future deployments.
- Verify pre-change validation steps for configuration push batches.

HIGH_PRB at a venue site, caused by the event.

truth.notes: trap=bad_change_loud_coincidence; A scheduled parameter optimisation batch pushed to the 3 sites of LNK-TUN-02-A regressed RRC success and drop rate until it was rolled back. Root cause node is the first site of the pushed group. Trap: a stadium event in the same region the same evening makes traffic and alarms noisy, and the change record looks innocent. Settled by: (1) the stadium event raises traffic at the venue sites, whereas the pushed sites are other sites that lose RRC success and volume; (2) the regression starts at the change time on exactly the pushed sites and ends at the rollback, long after the event.
